messages:
maria: FYI: hit 5x cold-starts this morning on spot-gpu-pool-usw1 (~03:20-03:45). Pods were Pending while autoscaler spun up preemptible nodes. We should consider a standby/overflow strategy.

infra-bot: Alert: node-preempted spot-gpu-abc123 at 2026-03-18T03:22:11Z. Eviction reason=preemptible, pods evicted: redis-cache-0, model-worker-5.

sam: Do we know if prepulling docker images on a tiny warm pool would avoid the Pending time? Autoscaler + GCE provisioning seems to be the long pole here, not k8s scheduling.

jonathan: Agree. Also saw cluster-autoscaler backoff spikes. Current flags: --scale-down-delay=10m, --max-node-provision-time=15m. Might bump max-node-provision-time to 20m to reduce thrash during mass preemptions.

kelly: Cost check: keeping a small standby of 2x A10s in us-west1 is roughly $1.8k/mo. If we go 4x that's ~ $3.6k/mo. What's the acceptable burn vs SLO benefit?

maria: SLO: 95th percentile startup latency <= 6s; recent cold starts hit 18–22s for model-worker. Proposal: hybrid approach — 1–2 hot on-demand nodes (stable), + 2–4 preemptible standby with taint, plus image prepulling.

sam: Concrete plan: create nodepool 'standby-gpu-small' with taint gpu=standby:NoSchedule, tolerations only on critical deployments. Use a Spillover controller to move non-critical load to preemptible pool when available.

ryan: Oncall note: if we introduce on-demand standby, add runbook steps for graceful failover. Steps: 1) cordon preempted node 2) drain with --grace-period 120 3) scale up standby pool 4) update routing fallback.

maria: I'll run a small experiment tomorrow: 1 on-demand A10 + 3 preemptible P100 with prepull. Who can pair for verification and metrics? @sam @jonathan?

sam: :thumbsup: I can join. Also please add a node startup-script to prepull images e.g. `sudo docker pull gcr.io/redwood/model:v2` so image pull doesn't dominate pod startup.

jonathan: Also add a lightweight DaemonSet to prefetch layer cache and warm KV caches to avoid KV-cache misses on cold starts. Example snippet to run as init container on standby nodes:

```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: image-prepull
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - name: pull
        image: alpine
        command: ["sh","-c","docker pull gcr.io/redwood/model:v2 || true"]
      containers:
      - name: noop
        image: busybox
        command: ["sh","-c","sleep 3600"]
```

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for nodepool 'standby-gpu-small': pipeline/infra/create-nodepool #436. Status: queued.

kelly: If we move forward, tag the pool with billing labels: `standby_pool=true` and add a billing alert threshold at $4k/month. Also we should run a cost-sensitivity sim for 1/3/6 month horizons.

maria: Thanks all — I'll open a PR with CA flag changes, nodepool spec, and the experiment checklist. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the prototype; will post results and perf numbers after the run.
